title: Pharmakon: an uncertainty-aware, 2,000-year map of Greek and Byzantine pharmacology
description:
Pharmakon reads Dioscorides' De materia medica in Greek, gives a probability for the modern species behind each ancient plant name (with an explicit "unidentified" option), traces every use through Galen, John the Physician and modern Greek villages, runs a leakage-free temporal backtest, and ranks untested plant–condition research leads with toxicity and conservation flags. Every extracted claim quotes the exact Greek words it comes from.

Includes the pipeline (13 CLI stages, Parquet tables with provenance), the website, JSON API and MCP server (Cloudflare Workers), the research dashboard, and the processed tables.

Research hypotheses only, not medical advice.

Live site: https://pharmakon.adoranto737.workers.dev · Film: https://youtu.be/d-kbvFd2K04
